select content.block_content_id, content.block_id, content.title, content.`desc`, content.remark, content.page_file, img.filepath as image_url, img.file_id, pages.path as page_url, pages.pages_id, block.type, page_file.filepath as page_name from cms_block_content content left join s_file img on img.file_id = content.image_url left join wx_pages pages on pages.pages_id = content.page_url left join cms_block block on block.block_id = content.block_id left join s_file page_file on page_file.file_id = content.page_file where content.flag != -1 and content.block_id = #{param.blockId}
and block.name like #{name}
